# agents v0.9.0 — three skills travel with the repository

`init` installs three skills instead of one: the recording instruction it always
shipped, and the two authoring skills this repository's own work was written under.

## What changed

**`writing-for-humans` and `reviewing-with-a-team` are bundled.** `agents init`
writes them into `.agents/skills/` beside `recording-what-you-learn`. The first
covers what a text must mean, the order a reader needs, and the sentence habits
worth fixing last; the second covers the three review lenses, the prompts that make
each of them produce findings, and the delivery gate that decides when text is safe
to ship. Both are procedure rather than knowledge about one repository, which is
what makes them travel.

**The binary has one list of skills, not two.** The name list `init` iterates and
the lookup that resolves a name to its text were separate, and agreed by hand. They
are one list now, and the guards iterate it instead of naming a skill, so a skill
cannot be added to the binary and installed unchecked.

**`doctor` reports every bundled skill.** It carried one hardcoded check,
`scaffold:skill-recording`, so the two new skills would have been invisible to it —
neither present nor missing, which is the one outcome a diagnostic must not produce.
It now reports one `scaffold:skill-<name>` per bundled skill. On a repository that has
not re-run `init`, the two new skills report as missing with the remedy, which is the
truth about that repository.

**A bundled asset may not cite a dated document.** An asset lands in repositories
where this repository's documents have never existed, so a citation to
`docs/design/<date>-<slug>.md` sends its reader to nothing. `recording-what-you-learn`
did exactly that until v0.8.1, and it is now a check rather than a habit — the check
fails on a name like that anywhere under `assets/`, its comment records the mutation
that demonstrates it, and nothing shipped names one today.

**`init`'s summary says what it writes.** The generated command table in a
repository's root `README.md` now reads "create .agents/, the doc stores, the bundled
skills, and the wiring".

## Upgrading

```
brew upgrade agents
```

Nothing to convert.

**The two new skills reach new repositories only.** `init` writes a skill where the
path is absent and never over one that exists, so an initialized repository keeps
what it has. To adopt either text, copy it from
`agents/internal/scaffold/assets/skills/` — and note that the copy then belongs to
the repository, which is why `doctor` reports a divergence from the binary as OK
rather than as a fault, for all three skills now that its check iterates them.

## Checks

`agents` 10 packages (8 with tests) and `bootstrap.d` 6, whole runs; the documents
guards; and the CI gate on Debian and Arch (stage zero included), macOS, and the
hygiene legs.
